integrity: All-dimensional reasoning and a self-contained finite-case checker are supplied. Finite enumeration and seeded simulation are checks, not asymptotic proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the ordinary Frobenius Euclidean metric and independent uniform incident-edge sampling with replacement. It gives convergence in distribution, not finite-dimensional independence, rates of convergence or arbitrary moment convergence. Historical priority remains provisional because unindexed probabilistic equivalent formulations may exist.
title: Poisson-scale incident-edge angles in Birkhoff polytopes
